name: Carmel Flood
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: Carmel is a qualified Mental Health Counsellor with a Diploma in Counselling and an Associate Degree in Psychology. Carmel takes a trauma-informed, person-centred approach and has a strong understanding of the recovery model. Carmel works with clients facing a range of challenges, including depression, anxiety, grief, women’s health concerns, addiction, and trauma.

name: Carolynne Compton
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: Carolynne holds a Master of Counselling Degree, with her natural warmth, keen insight and empathy being an intrinsic part of her counselling practice. She assists clients with challenging experiences, as well as their relationships with themselves, others and the world around them integrating PCT, CBT, DBT, ACT, SFBT and other modalities, adapting her approach to support each person's unique needs. Carolynne enjoys working with clients of all ages in a safe and non-judgemental way to support whatever difficulties they wish to explore including: anxiety, depression, traumatic experiences, grief and loss, suicidality and self-harm, as well as relationships and workplace concerns.

name: Cena Farahmand
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: Registered Counsellor (M.A.C.A) Cena Farahmand is a dedicated, culturally responsive registered counsellor committed to providing a safe, confidential, and non-judgmental space for individuals navigating life transitions, emotional stress, anxiety, and settlement challenges . With a deep commitment to mental health advocacy, particularly within Culturally and Linguistically Diverse (CALD) communities, Cena bridges critical support gaps by offering counselling in English, Dari, Hazaragi and Persian (Farsi) . His approach is grounded in empathy and person-centred care, empowering clients to untangle complex emotional patterns, regulate stress, and foster personal resilience at their own pace.
